tags: why do dogs sleep so much
script: If it feels like your dog sleeps their whole life away, that's actually completely normal. Adult dogs typically sleep twelve to fourteen hours a day, and puppies or senior dogs can sleep even more, sometimes up to eighteen hours. Unlike humans, dogs don't get all their rest in one long block. Their sleep is broken into many shorter naps throughout the day, which means they spend less time than us in the deepest, most restorative sleep stages, so they need more total hours to compensate. Breed and activity level matter too. Working breeds sleep a bit less with enough exercise, bigger breeds often sleep more. So that dog snoring at two in the afternoon isn't lazy, that's just healthy dog biology. Want more tips like this? The link in the bio has more.
